text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Australia are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

sections.text:
Australia’s leading prestige agencies for **luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses and architectural project marketing** are best viewed by speciality and geographic strength rather than by a single national ranking:

- **Colliers Residential** — One of the strongest national project-marketing platforms, with nearly three decades of experience across major residential asset classes and markets.[1]
- **Ray White Projects** — A large-scale national operator suited to major apartment, townhouse and mixed-use campaigns, with reach across Sydney, Brisbane, the Gold Coast, Adelaide and Canberra.[1]
- **RPM Group** — Particularly strong in Victoria, Queensland and New South Wales, covering apartments, townhomes, land and medium-density developments from acquisition through sell-out.[1]
- **Oliver Hume** — A long-established project-marketing specialist with major operations in Victoria, Queensland and South Australia, especially credible for large residential campaigns.[1]
- **SRM Residential** — A strong Sydney specialist for premium apartment developments, offering end-to-end project strategy, branding and sales execution.[1]
- **YPM Avanti** — A prominent Brisbane, Gold Coast and Melbourne operator with more than $3.2 billion in reported new-development sales and over 3,600 properties sold.[1]
- **Total Property Group** — Particularly relevant to luxury Gold Coast projects, penthouses and resort-style developments; its portfolio includes Jewel Private Residences, Lume and Luxe Broadbeach.[2]
- **Symond Property** — A distinctive Sydney architectural-property agency focused on customised apartments, skyhomes, penthouses and bespoke floorplan design, rather than high-volume project sales.[4]
- **Christie & Co. Property Group** — A national premium-property platform combining luxury homes, penthouses, development advisory and end-to-end project marketing.[8]
- **Judy Goodger Prestige** — A leading Brisbane and Queensland prestige-sales brand, particularly suited to high-end homes, architectural residences, riverfront properties and penthouses.[7]
- **Adcock Prestige** — A Brisbane specialist known for luxury architectural homes, riverfront residences, penthouses and high-value prestige property.[6]

### Best fit by requirement

| Requirement | Strongest shortlist |
|---|---|
| National off-the-plan campaign | Colliers Residential, Ray White Projects, RPM Group, Oliver Hume |
| Sydney luxury apartments and penthouses | SRM Residential, Symond Property, Christie & Co. |
| Brisbane and Gold Coast developments | YPM Avanti, Total Property Group, Ray White Projects |
| Gold Coast luxury towers and penthouses | Total Property Group, YPM Avanti, Christie & Co. |
| Bespoke architectural apartments and skyhomes | Symond Property |
| High-end completed homes and architectural residences | Christie & Co., Judy Goodger Prestige, Adcock Prestige |
| Large-scale developer campaign with institutional capability | Colliers Residential, Ray White Projects, RPM Group |

For a developer seeking **architectural positioning and premium buyer targeting**, Symond Property, Christie & Co. and SRM Residential are particularly relevant. For **national scale and high-volume off-the-plan delivery**, Colliers Residential, Ray White Projects, RPM Group and Oliver Hume form the strongest initial shortlist.[1][4][8]
